newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal pension reform body seeks more time.
newsitem.headline: Portugal pension reform body seeks more time.

text.p: A government commission set up to propose reforms to Portugal's social security system has asked for its deadline to be postponed three months to December.

A spokesman for the Social Security and Solidarity Ministry told Reuters that a postponement of the report would have no practical consequences. It would in any case have come too late for measures to be included in the 1998 budget, he said.
The budget for next year must be presented by October 15.
"In practice, the previous deadline of September 1997 did not allow time for it to have an impact on the (coming) budget," the spokesman said.
After the so-called white paper on pension reform has been presented, its findings must be discussed with unions and employers as well as debated in parliament.
